title: The Last Soldier: Another World
shortDescription: Survive enemy waves, upgrade your hero and climb the MMR leaderboard.
seoDescription: The Last Soldier: Another World is a pixel action game with enemy waves, bosses, hero upgrades and an MMR leaderboard. Play on PC or phone.
description:
Fight waves of enemies, defeat bosses and improve your hero. Spend collected coins on arrows, potions and upgrades.

Each fully cleared wave awards 100 MMR, and each defeated enemy adds 1 MMR. Your score accumulates and does not drop after defeat. Compare results on the leaderboard.

After defeat, return to camp or choose to watch a rewarded video to continue the same wave with full health. The merchant also offers 500 coins for watching a video.

Play without signing in. Yandex ID lets you transfer cloud progress between devices. Russian and English are available in Settings.
instructions:
PC: WASD or arrow keys to move; mouse to aim; left-click to fire. Q changes arrow type; 1, 2 and 3 select fire modes. Space raises your shield, Shift dashes, H uses a potion, hold E to use a mirror. Press F or click Merchant to shop; Esc opens the menu. Spread shot and automatic fire must be unlocked at the merchant.

Phone: use the left joystick to move. Tap Fire for an auto-aimed shot. In single-shot mode, hold and drag Fire to aim manually, then release to shoot. Use the shield, dash and potion buttons; customise their layout in Settings.

Enter the ARENA portal to fight. Return to camp for free between waves. A full clear awards 100 MMR and each defeated enemy adds 1. A video after defeat restores full health and keeps the wave; a merchant video awards 500 coins. Choose Auto, Русский or English in Settings.
